caption: The drawing depicts a black, long-sleeved woman's bodice with a high, standing collar and pointed waistband. The bodice is heavily adorned with intricate beadwork and embroidery in swirling, floral, and leaf-like patterns throughout the fabric. The sleeves are full and gathered at the shoulder, tapering toward the forearm, with additional beadwork forming horizontal decorative stripes and elongated fringes of beads hanging from the cuffs. The beadwork and embroidery are primarily gold and metallic in color, adding contrast and texture to the dark background of the garment. The entire bodice is presented against a plain, light background, and only the article of clothing is depicted without any visible figure or additional objects.
title: Basque
